components.name: Gift Reception & Validation
components.details: Constructs closure <>c__DisplayClass25_0, captures gift, this, onIncomeDelta, recipientOverride. Calls TeamStore.Change.

components.name: Diamond & System ID Filtering
components.details: Checks gift ID (e.g. 9981 diamond check, 12210 check). Rejects invalid gifts with "ignored" or "invalid".

components.name: Timing & Round Validation
components.details: Verifies occurrence time against round boundaries. Rejects out-of-round gifts with "invalid_time".

components.name: Recipient Resolution Hierarchy
components.details: Hierarchy: 1. recipientOverride; 2. Existing combo target lock; 3. sender_targets SQLite lookup (, ); 4. TeamPkGiftRule round goal mapping; 5. Unassigned / pending.

components.name: Combo Streak & Delta Calculation
components.details: Reads existing combo from SQLite via TeamStore.ReadCombo. Computes: deltaCoins = Math.Max(0, gift.Coins - existingCombo.Coins); deltaQuantity = Math.Max(0, gift.Quantity - existingCombo.Quantity); if deltaQuantity == 0 then deltaCoins = 0.

components.name: Ledger Journaling
components.details: Inserts ledger record into SQLite committed_ledger table with calculated delta coins, occurred_at timestamp, sender_id, member_id, and gift_id.
